angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.

radiusSource: Temperature 6076 +180/-92 K from the high-resolution spectroscopic analysis of Baburaj et al. (2026, arXiv:2608.15912), and stellar mass 1.20 +/- 0.06 solar masses from their Table 1.
